ownership_and_preservation.direct_call: & program @argv with immediate typed LASTEXITCODE; direct owned native call and logs sealed before solver output analysis. No Start-Process process-object exit recovery.
ownership_and_preservation.failure: Seal any returned typed/non-typed exit/launch error and generated files before rejecting. Never rerun a completed solver for reader/postprocessing failure; retain all records and output.
ownership_and_preservation.reader_provenance: Already-built immutable reader program, author files, recorded source-build/source-freeze identities, owned compile/link logs, tools/libraries and runtime copies are hashed. Historical source hash records remain archival; historical source originals are not claimed current and no old helper is rebuilt.
ownership_and_preservation.raw_closure: Old owned completion/raw output records and new generated solver file manifests are checked, including readonly old inputs and raw BI4; source/canonical/formal/server data are never changed.
